Anant Singh News: anant sinh ki beti ki shadi men umri bhari bhir ne ek bar phir unki rajnitik takat ko charcha men la diya. ab saval uth raha hai ki kya anant sinh is janasmarthan ko dekhte hue naee parti banane ka bara kadam uthaenge? naee parti ki charcha ke pichhe kya hai vajah, samjhie puri kahani sirph Bihar Tak par.
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
